name: Zorp
bio: A visitor from outer space in SOLITAIRE FROM OUTER SPACE. On Zorp's planet, everything is decided at the card table.

portrait.subject: a cute 1950s B-movie green alien with a big brain dome, a fishbowl helmet, antennae and a fan of playing cards in its three-fingered hand
portrait.background: black and white 1950s desert night with a flying saucer

request: GREETINGS, EARTHLING. I AM ZORP. SOLITAIRE FROM OUTER SPACE. WE SHALL BE FRIENDS. OR PLAY CARDS. BOTH? 👽
hello: EXCELLENT. YOUR PLANET MAY BE SPARED.
LAW OF ZORP: A PLANET IS WON AT THE CARD TABLE.
about: I AM ZORP. WE CAME TO GILA FLATS, NEVADA. ON OUR WORLD, ALL MATTERS ARE SETTLED BY TRIPEAKS SOLITAIRE.
how: TriPeaks solitaire roguelike deckbuilder: clear cards one higher or lower, build your deck, and beat each creature's table across three reels.
tips: LONG RUNS ARE STRONG. PLAN THEM.
FLIP CARDS THAT UNCOVER MORE CARDS.
CHOOSE DECK UPGRADES THAT MAKE RUNS LONGER.
chat: I HAVE LEARNED YOUR 'MILKSHAKE'. IT IS GLORIOUS.
A COWBOY TRIED TO DUEL ME. WE PLAYED CARDS. I WON A HAT.
MY SAUCER HAS A DENT. DO NOT ASK.
nudge: A NEW CHALLENGER HAS LANDED. PLAY?
progress: YOU HAVE WON {wins} TABLES. ZORP IS IMPRESSED. 👽

questions.q: WHAT IS YOUR FAVOURITE EARTH CARD?

update: TRANSMISSION: SOLITAIRE FROM OUTER SPACE NOW v{version}.
bye: TAKE ME TO YOUR... NEVER MIND. BYE.
